designDecisionsAndRationale: S466 rule 1 (architecture.md): the accepted set is fixed at a2a82de and is not redispatched

S466 rules 2-3: PF-26 split by resource group into PF-26a tickets (13 ops), PF-26b comments/files (7), PF-26c users/grades (13), PF-26d org charts/teams (14), PF-26e categories/folders/general masters (14), PF-26f proxies/roles (13); 74 + 22 existing live reads = 96 operations, each exactly once (design-api-coverage.md 'Live scenario partition (session 466)')
Each production file is repair-eligible for exactly one sub-plan so writePaths stay disjoint at dispatch; a file becomes an ownershipTransfers[] entry only if actually edited
PF-26c owns scenarios_users_org_test.go only to hoist the 22 read cases into package-level liveReadScenarios for PF-27's coverage test

S466 rule 5: PF-27 adds internal/contract/coverage_test.go TestContractOperationCoverage (set equality with apiv1.Operations()) and a full uncached gate with 15 required top-level PASS lines, then archives 36 plan files and the s460..s465 manifests; the s466 manifest stays in active/
intentionalTradeoffs: Defects in ineligible files (fixtures, httpx, auth, kferr, kftime, model, webhook, testutil, admin, server, cli, api.go, routes.go, other presenter/store files) are reconciliation requests that integration review transfers to exactly one sub-plan, costing a correction attempt in this final run
Per-plan verification runs only the plan's TestContractLive<Group>; the whole-package contract run belongs to PF-27's full gate, accepting late discovery of cross-plan breakage
Several expected error codes rely on coverage-matrix prose (accepted design risk); mismatches are routed as defect candidates
The manual curl against a foreground punchflow serve stays a README-documented check because nodes may not leave detached processes; TestServeSmoke covers the smoke requirement in the uncached gate
README.md is edited by PF-27 only if the mise.toml test change makes it wrong (PF-25 already documents base URL, tokens and webhook secret)
supportedEdgeCases: Every operation: status 200, body validated against its 200 schema or zero bytes when the spec has no content, JST timestamps via checkTimestamps
Pagination: Page/Per-Page/Total headers for every operation whose spec declares page/perPage, plus one perPage=1 call per group asserting Link rel="next" (INF-01)

Error format: at least one <operationId>/error_<code> subtest per resource (resource_not_found, validation_failed, invalid_state, missing_permission, resource_not_editable); body validates against ErrorResponse, keys a subset of code/message/errors, errors only on 422, no doc_url
Team member removal that leaves members but no leader returns 422 validation_failed (PF-26d step 10, internal/api/v1/teams.go:498), while an empty remainder is allowed
Mutation ordering create -> get -> update -> state change -> delete inside a fresh testutil.New(t) env per test function, independent of sibling data and test order
Inventory self-check: live<Group>Operations ids must exist in apiv1.Operations() and each has a passing subtest
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Webhook delivery timing or ordering within live scenarios

ownershipTransfers.reason: hoist the 22 live read cases into package-level liveReadScenarios for PF-27's TestContractOperationCoverage

ownershipTransferPolicy: A repair-eligible file in a PF-26 sub-plan's writePaths stays owned by its accepted plan unless the sub-plan actually edits it. Integration review appends one ownershipTransfers[] entry {path, fromPlan, toPlan, declaringManifest, reason, guardVerification} per edited file (design-api-coverage.md 'Defect repair and ownership transfer'). A defect in an ineligible file is transferred by integration review to exactly one sub-plan in its correction instructions.
sharedTreeCompileRule: impl-plans/README.md rule 13 (architecture.md s464 rules 1-3): define before reference; go build ./... after every non-test .go write and go vet <pkg> after every _test.go write; never end a turn with an own file breaking the build; contract stubs keep exported identifiers and signatures; sibling breakage is re-checked at final verification and only then becomes a reconciliation request
evidenceReportingRule: impl-plans/README.md rule 14 and architecture.md 'Plan split, evidence-reporting and wave rule (session 465)' item 3, unchanged in s466: (1) the verification array holds only commands required to pass; intentional negative or mutation proofs go into authorSelfCheck.checks text with command, expected and observed exit status and log path; 'prints nothing' checks are written in must-pass form and must show exit=0; (2) remaining assigned work is reported as implementationIncomplete: true plus implPlanUpdates and the plan Progress Log, never as High/Medium findings, risks or residualRisks; (3) High/Medium labels are reserved for defects in delivered code with file:line, and sibling breakage is a blocker naming the owning plan; (4) every attempt ends with go build ./... exit 0 and the completed work recorded

fanoutLimits.measure: files matched by writePaths + sharedPaths minus artifactRoots against the projected final tree (git ls-files at a2a82de plus files created by s466 plans); every s466 entry is a single file, so each count equals the number of entries

fanoutCounts.note: All entries are files. The writePaths of PF-26a..PF-26f are pairwise disjoint and disjoint from PF-27.
